weather.name: Clear skies
weather.text: The sky is clear from one edge to the other.

weather.name: Overcast
weather.text: Low grey cloud sits over everything like a lid.

weather.name: Rain
weather.text: Rain turns the roads to mud; footing is poor.

weather.name: Storm
weather.text: Thunder rolls; nobody travels who does not have to.

weather.name: Fog
weather.text: Fog lies in every hollow; anything a spear's length away is a guess.

weather.name: Heat wave
weather.text: The air is heavy and still, and the road throws the heat back up.

weather.name: Snow
weather.text: Snow lies deep; every mile is earned.

locations.name: Hearthmere
locations.description: A walled market town and the family's home. Smoke, bells and gossip.

locations.name: Greenvale
locations.description: Farmland and hedgerows; bandits work the lanes at dusk.

locations.name: Whisperwood
locations.description: Old trees that talk in the wind. The wolves here answer to something larger.

locations.name: Mirefen
locations.description: Black water and sucking mud. Things live in it that should not.

locations.name: Elderglade
locations.description: A ring of standing stones where the fae are said to dance.

locations.name: Ironford
locations.description: A dwarven trade town at the river crossing, loud with hammers.

locations.name: Goblin Warrens
locations.description: Tunnels gnawed into the hills; goblins breed here faster than they die.

locations.name: Hollow Barrow
locations.description: A barrow-king's tomb. The dead inside have not finished their work.

locations.name: Kingshold
locations.description: The crown city. Fine gear, finer prices, and eyes everywhere.

locations.name: Frostreach
locations.description: Endless white. The wolves here are bigger, and hungrier.

locations.name: Highcrag
locations.description: Knife-edged peaks where harpies nest and golems sleep in the scree.

locations.name: Emberpeak
locations.description: A smoking mountain. Vaerthax sleeps in its throat.

locations.name: Brinehaven
locations.description: A salt-stained port where anything can be bought and anyone can be hired.

locations.name: Stormcoast
locations.description: Cliffs battered by the sea; harpies wheel above the wrecks.

locations.name: Sunken Temple
locations.description: A drowned shrine to a forgotten god. Time runs strangely inside.

locations.name: Deepstone Halls
locations.description: Abandoned dwarf-halls. Something of stone walks them still.

locations.name: The Rift
locations.description: A wound in the world. The Unmade waits on the other side.
